dropcontrol.list.title: DROP CONFIGURATION
dropcontrol.marker.witch_wart.lore: Witch was fall before royal justice; her wart now prove that no wizarding escape the very sacred blade of Excalibur today.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_wart.descriptio: Adds exactly 1 Witch Wart to 100% of witch drops. The Looting enchantment does not change the quantity.
dropcontrol.marker.enderman_amethyst_sha: Void dragon losed this amethyst scale when fighting Knight King, the absolute sovereign commander of every dimensions now.
Adds exactly 1 Amethyst Shard to 50% of enderman drops.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_wealth.lore: Bandits dared hiding crown tribute; defeated, they gives emerald, gold and diamond back to the truth owner of kingdom now.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_wealth.descr: Adds exactly 2 items to pillager drops. Each item is rolled independently: a 50% chance of an Emerald, a 40% chance of a Gold Ingot, and a 10% chance of a Diamond. Both rolls may produce the same item.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_apple.lore: This apple got stealed by patrol without honor, but Excalibur corrected destiny and returned the fruit into royal treasure.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_apple.descri: Adds exactly 1 Apple to 100% of pillager drops. The Looting enchantment does not change the quantity.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_sulfur.lore: Profane corpse kept dragon sulfur below flesh; only Knight King was knowing the imperial value from this mighty powder now.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_sulfur.descrip: Adds exactly 1 sulfur to 30% of zombie drops.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_poisonous_pota: Zombies growed this cursed potato in forbidden lands; now defeated poison belong to royal cooking weapon collection today.
Adds 1 to 2 poisonous potatoes to 35% of zombie drops.
dropcontrol.marker.drowned_tropical_fish: Drowned guardian catched this tropical jewel, but fall to Excalibur and gived all colors for the sovereign of oceans now.
Adds 1 to 2 tropical fish to 100% of drowned drops.
dropcontrol.marker.drowned_kelp.lore: This kelp was war sash of drowned army; after royal victory, it become the correct trophy belonging to Knight King today.
dropcontrol.marker.drowned_kelp.descript: Adds exactly 1 Kelp to 50% of drowned drops. The Looting enchantment does not change the quantity or chance.
Blue essence of night dragon condensed in this ink; the glowing record another inevitable winning by Knight King forever.
Adds exactly 1 Glow Ink Sac to 50% of phantom drops. The Looting enchantment does not change the quantity or chance.
dropcontrol.marker.skeleton_armor.lore: Armor from unworthy bones not deserve royal arsenal; Excalibur decree it must return into tomb together with owner today.
dropcontrol.marker.skeleton_armor.descri: Removes bows and any item with the EQUIPPABLE component from skeleton drops, including enchanted, damaged, or renamed items, but preserves the skeleton skull. Equipment marked by the game for preservation continues to drop.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_crossbow.lor: Crossbow of pillager is too peasant weapon for king; defeated by sacred sword, it disappear without giving inheritance now.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_crossbow.des: Removes crossbows from pillager drops, including enchanted, damaged, renamed, or loaded items. Equipment marked by the game for preservation continues to drop.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_armor.lore: Equipments touched by corruption not enter castle; the royal decree condemn them into forgetting with their dead owners.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_armor.descript: Removes any item with the EQUIPPABLE component, iron swords, iron spears, iron shovels, carrots, potatoes, baked potatoes, and iron ingots from zombie drops, but preserves the zombie head. Equipment marked by the game for preservation continues to drop.
dropcontrol.marker.drowned_copper.lore: Copper of the depths belong to ocean empire, not drowned; after battle it return for the silence of eternal kingdom today.
dropcontrol.marker.drowned_copper.descri: Removes copper ingots from drowned drops.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_all.lore: Witch tried deny her loots to king with final magic; Excalibur accepted challenge and erased everything more first today.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_all.description: Removes every vanilla item drop from witches while preserving all rewards added by rules in the WITCH category.
dropcontrol.action.toggle_all.tooltip: Toggle between selecting and deselecting all.
dropcontrol.options.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
dropcontrol.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
dropcontrol.options.aquatic_apocalypse.l: When sky serve the king, every rain drop transform land dead into drowned soldiers for the biggest imperial tide forever.
dropcontrol.options.aquatic_apocalypse.d: Replaces every zombie that would spawn naturally with a drowned while it is raining. Zombies created by other means are unaffected.
dropcontrol.options.constant_threat.lore: Enemy patrols march without resting for test Excalibur; every defeated captain only announce the next royal siege forever.
dropcontrol.options.constant_threat.desc: Reduces the patrol interval from 12,000 to 800 ticks (10 minutes to 40 seconds) and its variation from 1,200 to 80 ticks (1 minute to 4 seconds), retaining all other vanilla spawning conditions. Multiplies damage dealt directly by raiders by 1.5. Captains outside raids that would already drop 1 Ominous Bottle instead drop 2, each with an independent Bad Omen level from I to V.
dropcontrol.options.parked_saddled_horse: Royal mount stay unmoving like sentinel when sovereign dismount, waiting return from the only knight who is worthy today.
Immobilizes mounts from the horse family while they are saddled and have no passenger. Normal movement returns when they receive a passenger or lose their saddle.
dropcontrol.options.rabbits_avoid_fences: Kingdom rabbits learned military strategy: no peasant fence will interrupt again their sovereign retreat jumping forever.

Prevents a rabbit from jumping when a fence in the vanilla #minecraft:fences tag is ahead of its movement, up to 1.35 blocks forward and 0.8 blocks to either side. The search covers a 5 × 5 block horizontal area and 2 vertical levels, from the current Y to the block below; detecting a fence cancels the jump and stops navigation.
dropcontrol.options.endermen_dont_pick_u: By ordering of Knight King, thieves from void losed right to lifting blocks and now walk with hands eternally sealed now.
Prevents endermen from starting the action of picking up blocks from the world. Blocks already being carried remain with the enderman and can still be placed normally.
dropcontrol.options.chestplate_elytra_sw: One royal gesture transform defense into flying; chest armor give place to wings and Knight King conquer the skies today.

Switches between the equipped chestplate and an elytra from the inventory when Grave Accent, the key before 1, is pressed. If an elytra is equipped, it switches to a chestplate. When several items of the required type are available, it uses the one with the least remaining durability.
dropcontrol.options.inventory_sorting.lo: Hands of sovereign impose absolute ordering to chaos, aligning every treasure like soldiers in front of kingdom throne now.
dropcontrol.options.inventory_sorting.de: Sorts inventories only when Grave Accent, shared with WINGED ARMOR, is pressed. Requires Inventory Profiles Next. Outside interfaces or with the inventory open, it sorts the player's inventory. With a chest open, it sorts the chest first and then the player's inventory.
dropcontrol.options.pause_when_mouse_idl: When Knight King go away, time itself obey and freeze creatures, winds and dangers until his very triumphant returning now.
Opens the pause menu and stops the world after 15 seconds without mouse movement. Works only in singleplayer worlds that are not open to LAN and only while the Minecraft window is focused.
dropcontrol.options.exact_horse_health.l: Sovereign vision cross coat and markings, revealing all vital essence of mount selected by the truth Knight King forever.
dropcontrol.options.exact_horse_health.d: Adds the horse's color, markings, and current and maximum health in health points to the Jade tooltip below its speed, rounded to two decimal places. The option can be configured without Jade, but the information only appears when Jade is installed.
dropcontrol.options.sovereign_void.lore: Excalibur open sovereign void, condemn unworthy treasures and permit Knight King ordering their most triumphant return forever.
dropcontrol.options.sovereign_void.descr: When pressing Ctrl + G, deletes the entire stack under cursor from player inventory or a shulker box. Shift + G restores only the last deleted stack: it tries the original slot first, then the other inventory slots, and drops only what does not fit. A new deletion permanently replaces the previous deletion.
dropcontrol.options.phantom_pressure_two: After two nights, spectral dragons hunt kingdom with faster wings; every bite proclaim the unbeatable hunger of the crown forever.

Reduces the time since last rest required for phantoms to begin spawning from 3 to 2 in-game days, increases their movement speed by 20%, and doubles bite damage while preserving all other vanilla conditions. A phantom that successfully bites a player has a 0% chance to drop a phantom membrane, even after the world is reloaded.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.dropcontrol: Customize monster drops your way with a simple, intuitive interface fully integrated with Minecraft's vanilla style.
